title: Firmware updates
description: Over-the-air updates: where to look for new firmware and how careful to be about a freshly installed image.

keys.name: manifest_src
keys.title: Where to look for updates
keys.description: url = the manifest URL below. signalk = ask the SignalK server this device is already connected to, so a device that finds its server also finds its updates and nothing has to be typed per device (needs a fleet-update plugin on that server).

keys.name: manifest_url
keys.title: Manifest URL
keys.description: http(s) URL of a version manifest (docs/ota.md). Empty = manual updates from a URL only. Ignored when the source above is signalk.

keys.name: manifest_path
keys.title: Manifest path on the server
keys.description: Path appended to the SignalK server's address when the source is signalk. The default is where the fleet-update plugin serves it.

keys.name: channel
keys.title: Channel
keys.description: Which channel of the manifest to follow, e.g. stable or beta.

keys.name: auto_check
keys.title: Check automatically
keys.description: Fetch the manifest after boot and every check interval.

keys.name: auto_install
keys.title: Install automatically
keys.description: Install a newer build from the manifest as soon as it is found (device reboots). Off = only show it.

keys.name: allow_insecure
keys.title: Skip TLS certificate check
keys.description: Accept any https certificate (self-signed boat servers). Images are still signature-checked.

keys.name: confirm_tmo_s
keys.title: Rollback timeout
keys.description: A freshly installed image must reach the network within this time, else the device rolls back to the previous firmware.
